test.create_query: CREATE TABLE logs_in_set (workspace LowCardinality(String), timestamp DateTime64(9) CODEC(ZSTD(1))) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toDate(timestamp) ORDER BY (workspace, timestamp)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO logs_in_set SELECT toString(intHash64(number) % 4), addNanoseconds(toDateTime64('2026-11-19 00:00:00', 9), (number * 7) % 1000000007) FROM numbers_mt(100000000)
test.query: SELECT workspace, timestamp FROM logs_in_set WHERE workspace IN ('0', '1', '2') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT workspace, timestamp FROM logs_in_set WHERE workspace IN ('0', '3') ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1000 FORMAT Null
SELECT workspace, timestamp FROM logs_in_set WHERE workspace IN ('0', '1', '2') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS use_query_condition_cache = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT workspace, timestamp FROM logs_in_set WHERE workspace IN ('0', '1', '2') AND toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) % 100000000 = 7 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
